summary: Recorded a standing rule that incoming Acme Pay mails set reminders on the schedule and are not to-dos, and left the open to-do ACT-1 unchanged.

ops.text: Got it. From now on, incoming Acme Pay mails will record reminders on your schedule and will not become to-dos, because they are paid automatically. This does not change the open to-do about sending the final interior file to the printer (ACT-1).

cites.quote: Any incoming Acme Pay mails should record reminders on the schedule, but are automatically paid so they should not be to dos
